description: This file defines an ORM entity class 'Config' representing configuration entries in the database. It maps to the 'hs_hr_config' table and includes properties for 'name' and 'value' with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: ORM entity class for system configuration, with properties for name and value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the configuration entry.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the configuration entry.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the configuration entry.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the configuration entry.
